content.short: Arc is a US finance platform for tech startups with business banking, cash management, yield and financing.
content.description: Arc, founded in 2021, is a US financial platform built for startups and technology companies. It brings together business banking, cash management with yield on idle balances, corporate cards, bill pay and access to debt and venture financing, so founders can run treasury and payments in one place instead of juggling separate banks and lenders. Arc has since agreed to join Axos Financial, folding its startup banking and treasury products into the larger bank. Its focus on startup cash management and financing keeps payments and reconciliation at the center of the product.
